unit_controls.label: remaining final Test Manager consumer closure

reasons: Verify remaining fixed-plan/source-pin consumers after typed unknown-effect correction; host controls run separately on identical final source

process_driver.source:
import base64, hashlib, json, os, select, shutil, signal, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
root_source = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root_source))
import issue_atom as atom
import schema_manager
source = r'''#include <sys/file.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc != 4 || strcmp(argv[1], "--project-dir") || strcmp(argv[3], "start")) return 2;
  if (chdir(argv[2])) return 3;
  int fd = open(".noodle/noodle.lock", O_CREAT|O_RDWR, 0600);
  if (fd < 0 || flock(fd, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB)) return 4;
  puts("ready"); fflush(stdout);
  for (;;) pause();
}
'''
receipt = {'schema': 1, 'kind': 'disposable process/config caller-seam integration',
           'authorizes_landing': False, 'production_noodle': False, 'fixture_c_source': source,
           'processes': [], 'calls': []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='soodles-209-process-') as directory:
    outer = Path(directory).resolve()
    root, foreign_root = outer/'owner', outer/'foreign'
    for p in (root, foreign_root):
        (p/'.noodle').mkdir(parents=True)
    cpath, binary = outer/'loop.c', outer/'loop'
    cpath.write_text(source)
    def run(argv, **kwargs):
        before = time.perf_counter_ns()
        p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, **kwargs)
        result = {'argv': [str(x) for x in argv], 'exit': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout,
                  'stderr': p.stderr, 'elapsed_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before}
        assert p.returncode == 0, result
        return result
    receipt['compile'] = run(['/usr/bin/cc', str(cpath), '-o', str(binary)])
    for name in ('schema_manager.py', schema_manager.PLAN_PATH):
        target = root/name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(root_source/name, target)
    run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(root)])
    run(['git', 'add', '.'], cwd=root)
    run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=Fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid',
         'commit', '-qm', 'Pin source for disposable owner boundary'], cwd=root)
    base = run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root)['stdout'].strip()
    original, installed, foreign_bytes = b'# original host fixture\n', b'# installed fixture\n', b'# foreign config\n'
    (root/'.noodle.toml').write_bytes(installed)
    (foreign_root/'.noodle.toml').write_bytes(foreign_bytes)
    children = []
    try:
        for project in (root, foreign_root):
            argv = [str(binary), '--project-dir', str(project), 'start']
            before = time.perf_counter_ns()
            child = subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            children.append(child)
            assert select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 5)[0], 'fixture readiness timeout'
            ready = child.stdout.readline().strip()
            assert ready == 'ready'
            receipt['processes'].append({'argv': argv, 'pid': child.pid, 'ready': ready,
                                         'startup_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before})
        own, foreign = children
        authorization = {'repository': 'ed3c/soodles', 'control_root': str(root), 'base_head': base,
                         'host_config_sha256': atom.digest_bytes(original), 'noodle': {'path': str(binary)}}
        state = {'authorization_sha256': 'a'*64, 'envelope_sha256': 'b'*64, 'phase': 'landing',
                 'noodle_start': {'pid': own.pid, 'argv': receipt['processes'][0]['argv'],
                                  'config_sha256': atom.digest_bytes(installed),
                                  'original_config': base64.b64encode(original).decode()}}
        paths = {'state': outer/'state.json'}
        landing = {'classification': 'RESOLVED', 'next': None, 'fixture': 'original landing-owner seam'}
        def invoke(label):
            before = time.perf_counter_ns()
            value = atom.finish_host(authorization, paths, state, landing=landing)
            receipt['calls'].append({'label': label, 'returned': value,
                'elapsed_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before,
                'checkpoint': json.loads(paths['state'].read_text()),
                'config_sha256': atom.host_config_identity(root)})
            return value
        assert invoke('stop original loop') is False
        assert state['noodle_start']['stop_offered'] is True
        receipt['processes'][0]['exit'] = own.wait(timeout=5)
        assert own.returncode == -signal.SIGTERM
        state = json.loads(paths['state'].read_text())
        assert invoke('restart/readback/restore/confirm') is True
        checkpoint_digest = atom.digest_file(paths['state'])
        assert invoke('identical replay') is True
        assert atom.digest_file(paths['state']) == checkpoint_digest
        assert (root/'.noodle.toml').read_bytes() == original
        assert foreign.poll() is None and (foreign_root/'.noodle.toml').read_bytes() == foreign_bytes
        receipt['own_ps_readback'] = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', str(own.pid), '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True).__dict__
        receipt['own_ps_readback'] = {k: receipt['own_ps_readback'][k] for k in ('args','returncode','stdout','stderr')}
        try:
            os.killpg(own.pid, 0)
            raise AssertionError('own group remains')
        except ProcessLookupError:
            receipt['own_group_absent'] = True
        receipt['foreign_before_fixture_cleanup'] = {'alive': foreign.poll() is None,
            'config_sha256': atom.digest_file(foreign_root/'.noodle.toml'), 'config_unchanged': True}
        receipt['original_config_sha256'] = atom.digest_bytes(original)
        receipt['terminal'] = atom.host_manager(authorization, state).project()
        assert receipt['terminal']['status'] == 'complete'
    finally:
        for child in children:
            if child.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=5)
        receipt['fixture_cleanup_exits'] = [child.returncode for child in children]
receipt['temporary_root_removed'] = not outer.exists()

import base64, hashlib, json, os, select, shutil, signal, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
root_source = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root_source))
import issue_atom as atom
import schema_manager
source = r'''#include <sys/file.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc != 4 || strcmp(argv[1], "--project-dir") || strcmp(argv[3], "start")) return 2;
  if (chdir(argv[2])) return 3;
  int fd = open(".noodle/noodle.lock", O_CREAT|O_RDWR, 0600);
  if (fd < 0 || flock(fd, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB)) return 4;
  puts("ready"); fflush(stdout);
  for (;;) pause();
}
'''
receipt = {'schema': 1, 'kind': 'disposable process/config caller-seam integration',
           'authorizes_landing': False, 'production_noodle': False, 'fixture_c_source': source,
           'processes': [], 'calls': []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='soodles-209-process-') as directory:
    outer = Path(directory).resolve()
    root, foreign_root = outer/'owner', outer/'foreign'
    for p in (root, foreign_root):
        (p/'.noodle').mkdir(parents=True)
    cpath, binary = outer/'loop.c', outer/'loop'
    cpath.write_text(source)
    def run(argv, **kwargs):
        before = time.perf_counter_ns()
        p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, **kwargs)
        result = {'argv': [str(x) for x in argv], 'exit': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout,
                  'stderr': p.stderr, 'elapsed_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before}
        assert p.returncode == 0, result
        return result
    receipt['compile'] = run(['/usr/bin/cc', str(cpath), '-o', str(binary)])
    for name in ('schema_manager.py', schema_manager.PLAN_PATH):
        target = root/name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(root_source/name, target)
    run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(root)])
    run(['git', 'add', '.'], cwd=root)
    run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=Fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid',
         'commit', '-qm', 'Pin source for disposable owner boundary'], cwd=root)
    base = run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root)['stdout'].strip()
    original, installed, foreign_bytes = b'# original host fixture\n', b'# installed fixture\n', b'# foreign config\n'
    (root/'.noodle.toml').write_bytes(installed)
    (foreign_root/'.noodle.toml').write_bytes(foreign_bytes)
    children = []
    try:
        for project in (root, foreign_root):
            argv = [str(binary), '--project-dir', str(project), 'start']
            before = time.perf_counter_ns()
            child = subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            children.append(child)
            assert select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 5)[0], 'fixture readiness timeout'
            ready = child.stdout.readline().strip()
            assert ready == 'ready'
            receipt['processes'].append({'argv': argv, 'pid': child.pid, 'ready': ready,
                                         'startup_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before})
        own, foreign = children
        authorization = {'repository': 'ed3c/soodles', 'control_root': str(root), 'base_head': base,
                         'host_config_sha256': atom.digest_bytes(original), 'noodle': {'path': str(binary)}}
        state = {'authorization_sha256': 'a'*64, 'envelope_sha256': 'b'*64, 'phase': 'landing',
                 'noodle_start': {'pid': own.pid, 'argv': receipt['processes'][0]['argv'],
                                  'config_sha256': atom.digest_bytes(installed),
                                  'original_config': base64.b64encode(original).decode()}}
        paths = {'state': outer/'state.json'}
        landing = {'classification': 'RESOLVED', 'next': None, 'fixture': 'original landing-owner seam'}
        def invoke(label):
            before = time.perf_counter_ns()
            value = atom.finish_host(authorization, paths, state, landing=landing)
            receipt['calls'].append({'label': label, 'returned': value,
                'elapsed_ns': time.perf_counter_ns()-before,
                'checkpoint': json.loads(paths['state'].read_text()),
                'config_sha256': atom.host_config_identity(root)})
            return value
        assert invoke('stop original loop') is False
        assert state['noodle_start']['stop_offered'] is True
        receipt['processes'][0]['exit'] = own.wait(timeout=5)
        assert own.returncode == -signal.SIGTERM
        state = json.loads(paths['state'].read_text())
        assert invoke('restart/readback/restore/confirm') is True
        checkpoint_digest = atom.digest_file(paths['state'])
        assert invoke('identical replay') is True
        assert atom.digest_file(paths['state']) == checkpoint_digest
        assert (root/'.noodle.toml').read_bytes() == original
        assert foreign.poll() is None and (foreign_root/'.noodle.toml').read_bytes() == foreign_bytes
        receipt['own_ps_readback'] = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', str(own.pid), '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True).__dict__
        receipt['own_ps_readback'] = {k: receipt['own_ps_readback'][k] for k in ('args','returncode','stdout','stderr')}
        try:
            os.killpg(own.pid, 0)
            raise AssertionError('own group remains')
        except ProcessLookupError:
            receipt['own_group_absent'] = True
        receipt['foreign_before_fixture_cleanup'] = {'alive': foreign.poll() is None,
            'config_sha256': atom.digest_file(foreign_root/'.noodle.toml'), 'config_unchanged': True}
        receipt['original_config_sha256'] = atom.digest_bytes(original)
        receipt['terminal'] = atom.host_manager(authorization, state).project()
        assert receipt['terminal']['status'] == 'complete'
    finally:
        for child in children:
            if child.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=5)
        receipt['fixture_cleanup_exits'] = [child.returncode for child in children]
receipt['temporary_root_removed'] = not outer.exists()
Path('/private/var/folders/l6/44bf7nvs64j60f1mpyy88hdm0000gn/T/soodles-209-base-integration-1tdewop0/physical.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'terminal': receipt['terminal'], 'exits': receipt['fixture_cleanup_exits'],
                  'foreign_unchanged': receipt['foreign_before_fixture_cleanup'],
                  'temporary_root_removed': receipt['temporary_root_removed']}))
